answer: Tie each agent action rate to a slashable capital bond, not to its headcount. Throughput is metered in proportion to staked value, so an operator who tries to forge a swarm of clones just splits one bond thinner across them, and each fake moves at a crawl. To match N honest agents an attacker must lock N times the capital, as hard to fake as a mined crystal, and any cheating burns the stake in a flash like a comet. Extra identities buy no bandwidth, only diluted, slashable weight.
